restore_assertions.label: the schema restored in full
restore_assertions.sql: select count(*) from information_schema.tables where table_schema='public'

notes: Outline has no username-and-password login. Without an identity provider configured, nobody can sign in — not even you. Set the OIDC values before the first start, or budget an hour for it.
Attachments are stored on local disk here rather than S3, which keeps the stack small and means the data directory must be in your backups. It is.
The app listens on 3000 rather than 80; Caddy handles the public ports.

validated.migrations_complete: 45 tables on first boot, ~18s; listening on :3000
